reviews.review: While this is no longer a live service game, there is still plenty of hours to be spent playing this. Gameplay can be souls like, but also very enjoyable

I personally had a great time playing, the game impressed me with its challenging combat, interesting world design, and the amount of freedom it gives players to build their characters. Whether playing solo or with friends, every run felt exciting because the game constantly surprised me with new enemies, locations, and rewards.

   I liked how each world feels unique and has its own atmosphere, secrets, and puzzles. The procedural generation keeps things fresh, making repeat playthroughs worthwhile instead of feeling repetitive. The boss fights are another highlight—they're challenging, creative, and satisfying to overcome after learning their mechanics.

I also liked the variety of weapons, archetypes, and character builds. There are so many ways to customize your playstyle that experimenting never gets old. The progression system rewards exploration, and discovering hidden items or secret areas is always satisfying.

I personally also appreciated the co-op experience. Playing with friends makes difficult encounters more enjoyable, and teamwork adds another layer of strategy. Even when playing alone, the game remains engaging thanks to its balanced difficulty.

I disliked that the difficulty can sometimes feel overwhelming, especially for new players. Some boss fights may require multiple attempts before figuring out the right strategy, which can be frustrating. I also disliked that important items or quests can be easy to miss because of the game's randomly generated worlds, sometimes requiring additional playthroughs.

 Pros
+ Excellent and satisfying combat.
+ Great variety of weapons and character builds.
+ Unique worlds with strong replay value.
+ Challenging and memorable boss fights.
+ Fun and rewarding co-op gameplay.
+ Lots and LOTS of secrets, puzzles, and exploration.

Cons
- Can be very difficult for newcomers and many mobs have too many stun attacks.
- Random generation may hide important content and you have to retry generate another one...
- Some bosses require to many retries.
- Story sometimes isn't there (many times I forgot what as the main objective of the main story missions).

 Conclusion
 I personally think this game is an excellent action RPG and one of the best co-op shooters available. I liked its deep customization, rewarding exploration, and exciting combat, while I disliked the occasional difficulty spikes and the randomness that can make finding certain content frustrating. Overall, the positives far outweigh the negatives, and I would highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys challenging games with plenty of replayability.
